The worst case, ss/125C/1.62V, is about 0.6x of that, which still clears 940 MHz. A long-L floor NMOS guarantees oscillation at vctrl=0.7 V. The PMOS side is unstarved to avoid headroom problems from its 1 V Vth. An inverter buffer gives rail-to-rail swing and isolates CL. Power stays near 0.3 mW at TT and below 0.9 mW at ff/-40C/1.98V."}

PARAMS = {
    "Istg": (35e-6, 15e-6, 100e-6),   # starving current per stage at TT, vctrl=mid
    "Lst":  (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),        # starving NMOS length
    "Wn":   (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),        # ring inverter NMOS width
    "Wp":   (1.68, 0.84, 6.0),        # ring inverter PMOS width
    "Lf":   (4.0, 1.0, 15.0),         # floor (always-on) NMOS length -> min frequency
    "Wbn":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # output buffer NMOS width
    "Wbp":  (2.0, 0.84, 8.0),         # output buffer PMOS width
    "Rfb":  (20e3, 5e3, 100e3),       # kick-coupling resistor vout -> in-phase ring node
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 3

    # Starving NMOS width from the forward model: Id per um at vgs = vmid
    idw = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["Lst"], vmid, 0.3)["Id"]
    Wst = max(0.42, min(200.0, p["Istg"] / max(idw, 1e-9)))

    # Floor device: tiny current at gate = VDD keeps the ring alive at low vctrl
    Wf = 0.42

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i - 1]          # input = previous stage output (ring wraps)
        y = nodes[i]
        s = f"s{i}"
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], 0.15)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, s, "vss", "nfet", p["Wn"], 0.15)
        n.M(f"MS{i}", s, "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wst, p["Lst"])
        n.M(f"MF{i}", s, "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wf, p["Lf"])

    # Output buffer: vout = inv(n2), in phase with n0 = inv(n2)
    n.M("MBP", "vout", nodes[N - 1], "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wbp"], 0.15)
    n.M("MBN", "vout", nodes[N - 1], "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbn"], 0.15)
    # Couples the start-up kick on vout into the ring (no DC current in steady state)
    n.R("RK", "vout", nodes[0], p["Rfb"])

    # ---- first-order performance prediction (TT, 27C, 1.8 V) ----
    cn = lut.op("n", p["Wn"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cp = lut.op("p", p["Wp"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cbn = lut.op("n", p["Wbn"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cbp = lut.op("p", p["Wbp"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cnode = 1.6 * (cn + cp) + 2e-15                # gate + drain junction + wiring
    cnode_last = cnode + (cbn + cbp)

    ip = lut.op("p", p["Wp"], 0.15, VDD, VDD / 2)["Id"]

    def period(istg):
        tf = cnode * VDD / 2 / istg
        tr = cnode * VDD / 2 / max(ip, 1e-9)
        tf_last = cnode_last * VDD / 2 / istg
        tr_last = cnode_last * VDD / 2 / max(ip, 1e-9)
        return (N - 1) * (tf + tr) + tf_last + tr_last

    def istg_at(v):
        return lut.op("n", Wst, p["Lst"], v, 0.3)["Id"] + lut.op("n", Wf, p["Lf"], VDD, 0.3)["Id"]

    f_lo = 1.0 / period(istg_at(vlo))
    f_mid = 1.0 / period(istg_at(vmid))
    f_hi = 1.0 / period(istg_at(vhi))

    cl = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    cring = N * cnode + (cbn + cbp)
    p_dyn = (cring + cl + 2e-15) * VDD ** 2 * f_mid
    power = 1.3 * p_dyn                              # crowbar allowance

    return n, {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / f_lo,
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
        "swing": 0.97 * VDD,
        "power": power,
    }
